description:
Analysis extent for Earthquake, Syrian Arab Republic, Türkiye, 6 February 2023 (EQ20230206SYR): 377 features merged from 377 source layers. Layers whose names mark the area UNOSAT analysed, or parts of it with no usable imagery (analysis extent, area of interest, cloud obstruction, no-data, image footprint). The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [6 February 2023 M 7.8 Marash/Antep (Kehramanmarash) Earthquake, Preliminary Satellite-Based Comprehensive Damage Assessment Report](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/6-february-2023-m-7-8-marash-antep-kehramanmarash-earthquake-preliminary-satellite-based-c)
- [Damage Assessment  in Jableh City, Jableh District, Latakia Province, Syria as of 9 February 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-jableh-city-jableh-district-latakia-province-syria-as-of-9-february-2)
- [Damage Assessment Istamo (Latakia) as of 9 February 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-istamo-latakia-as-of-9-february-2023)
- [Damage Assessment in A'zaz City, Aleppo Governorate, Syria as of 9 February 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-a-zaz-city-aleppo-governorate-syria-as-of-9-february-2023)
- [Damage Assessment in Al Bab, Qabasin and Bza'a towns, Syria as of 11 February 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-al-bab-qabasin-and-bza-a-towns-syria-as-of-11-february-2023)
- [Damage Assessment in Al Bab, Syria as of 11 February 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-al-bab-syria-as-of-11-february-2023)
- [Damage Assessment in Idlib City, Syria as of 9 February 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-idlib-city-syria-as-of-9-february-2023)
- [Damage Assessment in Jindires and the surrounding area, Syria as of 10 February 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-jindires-and-the-surrounding-area-syria-as-of-10-february-2023)
- [Damage Assessment in Jindires, Afrin District, Aleppo Governorate, Syria as of 11 February 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-jindires-afrin-district-aleppo-governorate-syria-as-of-11-february-20)
- [Damage Assessment in Jisr al-Shughur City (Idleb) as of 9 February 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-jisr-al-shughur-city-idleb-as-of-9-february-2023)
- [Damage Assessment in Killi (Idlib District), Syria as of 16 February 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-killi-idlib-district-syria-as-of-16-february-2023)
- [Damage Assessment in Lilawa Village, Jarablus District, Aleppo Governorate, Syria as of 7 February 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-lilawa-village-jarablus-district-aleppo-governorate-syria-as-of-7-feb)
- and 5 more; the event's [catalog page](../catalog.json) lists them all.

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: Shape_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: Shape_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: Site_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = UN Building; 1 = Mosque; 2 = Hospital; 3 = Refugee / IDP Camp Building; 4 = Market; 5 = School / University; 6 = Square; 7 = Government Building; 9 = Border Crossing Point; 12 = Cemetary; 13 = Ruins; 16 = Staduim; 19 = Sewage Treatment Facility; 21 = Greenhouse; 22 = Bridge; 23 = Road; 24 = Tower; 25 = Prison; 26 = Building (General / Default); 27 = Field; 28 = Industrial Facility; 30 = Refugee / IDP Camp Site; 35 = Transport Vehicle; 40 = Military Base; 41 = Checkpoint; 42 = Military Facility; 45 = Suspected Mass Grave Site; 46 = Airport Facility; 47 = Church. The decoded text is in `Site_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Site_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Site_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 11 = EB; 18 = TH; 22 = WP; 33 = LB; 44 = JL; 45 = MD; 54 = HP; 55 = VG; 57 = PG; 66 = CJ; 70 = SG; 73 = RS; 77 = LD; 88 = HK; 91 = KA; 99 = ER; 100 = KM; 111 = MBF; 121 = CN; 131 = SB; 141 = KJP; 151 = MNY; 161 = DC; 171 = SR; 181 = NL; 191 = DH; 212 = MH; 213 = JT; 214 = ES; 215 = KB; 216 = JY; 218 = PA; 219 = SS; 220 = MM; 221 = CD; 222 = CS; 1000 = Unknown. The decoded text is in `StaffID_label`.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = WorldView-1; 2 = WorldView-2; 3 = QuickBird-2; 4 = Ikonos; 5 = GeoEye-1; 6 = Formosat-2; 7 = SPOT-5; 8 = WorldView-3; 9 = MODIS-Aqua; 10 = MODIS-Terra; 11 = ASTER; 12 = EO-1 ALI; 13 = EO-1 Hyperion; 14 = MERIS; 15 = Landsat-7; 16 = Landsat-5; 17 = ASAR WSM; 18 = ASAR IMP; 19 = ASAR GM1; 20 = ASAR AP; 21 = Radarsat-1; 22 = Radarsat-2; 23 = TerraSAR-X; 24 = CosmoSkyMED; 25 = SPOT-4; 26 = ALOS PALSAR; 27 = ASAR IMM; 30 = UAV (Swinglet-Cam); 33 = Alos AVNIR; 35 = Pleiades; 36 = DMC; 37 = RISAT-1; 38 = RISAT-2; 39 = RESOURCESAT-1; 40 = Landsat-8; 41 = SPOT-6; 42 = Sentinel-1; 43 = Kompsat-2; 44 = Sentinel-2; 45 = Sentinel-3; 46 = Kompsat-3; 47 = Deimos-2; 48 = TripleSat; 49 = PlanetLabs; 50 = RapidEye; 51 = WorldView-4; 52 = SPOT-7; 999 = Combination of Sensors. The decoded text is in `SensorID_label`.

table:columns.name: GlobalID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS global identifier of the feature.

table:columns.name: SensorID_label
table:columns.description: `SensorID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
